Direct integrations with central bank payment rails yield an unassailable unit cost advantage, founder-led culture of radical transparency, and fortress balance sheet with over £12B in cash/customer balances and minimal net corporate debt. qualitative.evidence: Revenue compounded from £1,052M in FY2024 to £1,212M in FY2025 with Profit Before Tax reaching £565M and net profit £417M. Tangible ROE exceeds 25-30% on corporate capital. Low capex requirements (<£30M) yield FCF conversion exceeding 100% of net income. Direct connections to central bank settlement systems (UK Faster Payments, Australia NPP, Europe SEPA) create a structural cost floor that commercial banks cannot match without cannibalizing high-margin legacy fee structures.
